reply.text:
Honestly, a good chest pump on flys is one of the more satisfying parts of training, and flys are a fine finisher. Cables keep tension on the chest through the whole range, which is why you feel it so much.

Just keep the burn as a bonus rather than the goal. What drives progress is adding reps or weight over the weeks with clean form, and a heavy press does more for your chest than any fly. Fly 2 to 3 sets after your pressing, slow on the way back, a soft bend in the elbows, and stop a rep or two before your shoulders start doing the work.

Want me to add flys to a day in your program, or build you a chest session?
